9,000' Tandem Skydive



An introductory tandem skydive from 9,000'. You'll leap out of a perfectly good airplane at 9,000' for a quick 'air-bath' and enjoy approximately 30 seconds of exhilarating and adrenaline-soaked freefall.

Once your parachute is deployed, you'll enjoy a 4-5 minute scenic parachute flight with full 360° panoramic views of the beautiful California landscape; from the Sierra Nevada mountains, across the Napa & Sonoma Valleys to the San Francisco Bay.

Includes:

  • A handwritten & signed jump certificate.
  • A SkyDance SkyDiving bumper sticker.

This gift certificate is valid at:

SkyDance SkyDiving
24390 Aviation Ave
Davis, CA 95616

You are purchasing a Gift Card through our convenient Burble Software Booking System. Our company website is SkyDanceSkyDiving.com.

Please contact us directly if you have any questions or to schedule your jump.
(530) 753-2651
manifest@skydanceskydiving.com

Terms and Conditions:

  1. All gift certificate purchases are final.
  2. Gift certificates are transferable.
  3. Skydiver must be at least 18 years of age on the day of their skydive.
  4. Skydiver must be under 250lbs.
  5. There will be an additional $20 fee for skydivers over 220lbs.
  6. 9,000' Tandems are only offered on weekdays.
  7. This Gift Certificate is valid for the experience at the purchased price for a period of 1 year from the purchase date. Gift certificates "expire" one year from their purchase date. After the Expiration Date, the gift certificate may be redeemed for the purchased cash value; if our prices have increased, any additional amount will be due.
  8. May upgrade to a 13,000' jump during the initial 12 month period for an additional $50

18,000' Tandem Skydive



For the most extreme adrenaline junkies, our Ultimate Tandem skydive brings you into the realm of thin air and spectacular views. Leaping from the plane at 18,000', you'll get approximately 90 seconds of exhilarating and adrenaline-soaked freefall - a full 50% more freefall than a standard 13,000' leap!

Once your parachute is deployed, you'll enjoy a 4-5 minute scenic parachute flight with full 360° panoramic views of the beautiful California landscape; from the Sierra Nevada mountains, across the Napa & Sonoma Valleys to the San Francisco Bay.

Supplementary oxygen is provided for the climb to altitude to ensure your safety & comfort, but it's the rush of pure adrenaline that will fuel this unforgettable adventure.

Includes:

  • A handwritten & signed jump certificate.

Learn to Skydive - Ground School & 1st AFF Skydive



This is for those wanting to take the first step in learning to skydive on their own! This package includes a 4-6 hour First Jump Course (Ground School) & a 13,000' AFF skydive, where you'll jump with your own equipment under the supervision and assistance of 2 qualified instructors. You'll guide your own parachute back to the ground! *All jumpers participating must join the USPA as temporary or full members at their own expense*

Terms and Conditions:

  1. All gift certificate purchases are final.
  2. Gift certificates are transferable but not refundable under any circumstances.
  3. Skydiver must be at least 18 years of age on the day of their jump.
  4. Skydiver must be under 250lbs.
  5. No other discounts apply.
  6. Gift certificates expire 12 months from date of purchase. Certificates are worth cash value towards any skydiving experience after expiration.
  7. Jumper must join the United States Parachute Association as a member at their own expense before making an AFF skydive
